title: Sources: SpaceX's IPO has attracted $70B+ in orders from retail investors, who are expected to be allocated at least 20% of the available shares (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: SpaceX's IPO has attracted $70B+ in orders from retail investors, who are expected to be allocated at least 20% of the available shares — SpaceX's initial public offering has attracted more than $70 billion in orders from retail investors, according to people familiar with the matter …
